verdict.rationale: The firm's EC&VC page says its core focus is investor fundraising 'from seed and Series A through to larger institutional and growth rounds', covering term sheets, valuation mechanics and investor rights. The same page names representative deals: N26's billion-dollar round with Third Point, Coatue and Dragoneer, and the Flock relationship from start-up to exit. Missing for 10: quantified deal volume (only the qualitative 'one of Europe's most active' claim), more than one named priced-round example across stages, and independent corroboration.
